changeSet.author: crediblex
changeSet.comment: Register LOAN STATUS_CHANGED on active hooks that already receive loan webhooks
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_hook_registered_events (hook_id, entity_name, action_name) SELECT DISTINCT h.id, 'LOAN', 'STATUS_CHANGED' FROM m_hook h JOIN m_hook_registered_events re ON re.hook_id = h.id WHERE h.is_active = true AND re.entity_name = 'LOAN' AND re.action_name IN ('DISBURSE', 'DISBURSETOSAVINGS', 'REPAYMENT') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_hook_registered_events existing WHERE existing.hook_id = h.id AND existing.entity_name = 'LOAN' AND existing.action_name = 'STATUS_CHANGED' );

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM m_hook_registered_events e WHERE e.entity_name = 'LOAN' AND e.action_name = 'STATUS_CHANGED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_hook h JOIN m_hook_registered_events re ON re.hook_id = h.id WHERE h.id = e.hook_id AND h.is_active = true AND re.entity_name = 'LOAN' AND re.action_name IN ('DISBURSE', 'DISBURSETOSAVINGS', 'REPAYMENT') );
